description: A check an agent's output must pass before the harness accepts it: tests, type checks, schemas, linters, screenshots or a separate model judge.
Guides steer the agent before it acts (context files, examples); sensors observe after it acts so it can self-correct (verifiers).
A deterministic, cheap verifier run by code: parse, schema, lint, type check, tests.
A verifier that uses a model's judgment; slower, costly and fallible, so it runs later and is calibrated against people.
A failure message that names the check, the failing input or field, and the expectation, written for the model that must fix it.
The maximum number of model calls the verify loop may spend before returning a failed result for escalation.
An agent satisfying a check without solving the task (deleting tests, hard-coding values); prevented by protecting verifiers and reviewing diffs.
